summary:
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — [#666](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/666) fixes the pseudo-layer position calculation in the ALLEGRO HCAL three-parts endcap drivers (`HCalThreePartsEndcap_o1_v02/v04`) so that PandoraPFA clustering receives correct layer geometry; users of ALLEGRO reconstruction should re-run any workflows relying on the previous (incorrect) pseudo-layer positions. [#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662) extends `dd4hep2root.py` to map volume colours onto the closest predefined ROOT colours, improving downstream visualisation (e.g. via root2gltf). [#651](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/651) also refreshes `CODEOWNERS` for the FCCee sub-tree, adding jbeirer and reshuffling per-detector ownership so notifications land with the right maintainers.
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — [#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524) hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy to work around a wrong-overload selection in Python bindings; a temporary workaround until the deprecated API is removed.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — [#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431) adds a `--evt-max` alias to `k4run` matching `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax`, making the CLI more discoverable; note the argparse value still overrides values set in steering files. [#427](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/427) and follow-up [#428](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/428) refactor the internal test suite to use functional algorithms (retiring the legacy ROOT-file and Marlin-wrapper producers), which is a useful reference for users migrating their own components.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — [#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/103) adds a `SortEdges` option to the GNN track-finding pipeline that re-orients graph edges to point from the hit closer to the IP outward, matching the ACORN training convention (essential for correct inference). [#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104) and [#98](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/98) adapt to upstream ACTS API changes (named `TrackingGeometryMaterial` struct, propagator and grid-bin-finder updates); users building against older ACTS releases will need to update. [#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97) makes `--compactFile` required in the CKF, GNN, and geometry-visualisation option scripts, replacing a cryptic Gaudi error with a clear argparse message.
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — [#1663](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1663) fixes `Geant4Output2EDM4hep` (and the LCIO/ROOT outputs) in multi-threaded mode so that ingested run parameters and file parameters correctly end up in the output, along with proper endRun locking — an important correctness fix for MT ddsim jobs writing EDM4hep. [#1666](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1666) adds a new `kUpstreamTrapezoid` mask type in `Mask_o1_v01_geo` to support the non-cylindrically-symmetric FCC MDI synchrotron radiation mask (paired with k4geo #648). [#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681) removes the CSG-based DDCAD ASSIMP exporter because ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private; the author flagged that this loses functionality and a replacement (PR #1682) is being prepared, so downstream users of CAD export should be aware of the temporary regression.
- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora)** — [#54](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/54) updates the PFO comparison test script to be compatible with the current EDM4hep API after EDM4hep#520.
- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — [#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386) extends the truth-track / tracking-validation switch (from #379) to the IDEA `o1_v03` full-sim reco and exposes `--addTruthTracks` / `--runTrkValidation` through the IDEA and ALLEGRO ctest wrappers, so validation can be enabled directly from CI runs.
- **[HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies)** — [#61](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies/pull/61) documents the FSR beam parameters (still on the GHC lattice while LCC values above the Z pole are unavailable, though IP-level parameters are similar).
- **[HEP-FCC/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — [#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15) shrinks children volumes overlapping their parents to avoid tessellation artefacts, lowers `numFaces` to 1000, bumps transparency to 100%, and cleans up the conversion logic; visibly improves ALLEGRO/CLD/IDEA geometry visualisations.
- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials)** — [#201](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials/pull/201) points the visualisation tutorial at the `dd4hep2root` utility shipped with k4geo instead of a stale static copy, and [#198](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials/pull/198) refreshes the eedE tutorial with updated screenshots and feature documentation.
- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-drs](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs)** — [#88](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs/pull/88) adds a coordinator-only `production_ids` table so DIRAC/iLCDirac production IDs can be recorded (with labels and activity-log entries) once a request is assigned to a campaign.
